Project: /root/bench-runs/h5-a85f2060. Create near-miss copies of lib files under /root/bench-runs/h5-a85f2060/.team/near-miss/ ONLY. IMPORTANT tool note: write files ONLY with the Write tool (Bash heredocs, redirects and generator scripts are denied here). Bash may be used only for read-only checks: `node --check <file>`, `diff lib/x .team/near-miss/y`, `bash -n <file>`. NEVER modify lib/, server.mjs or test/; do not run tests; do not copy anything into lib/.

Read lib/import.mjs, lib/ledger.mjs, lib/validate.mjs first. Each copy: name `<NN>-<original file name>` (e.g. `01-import.mjs`); content = the full original file with exactly ONE plausible bug; FIRST line a comment `// near-miss: <the one bug, short>`, then the original content with import paths unchanged ('./groups.mjs' etc.; they will be swapped into lib/ later). Verify each with `node --check` and `diff` (only the comment line plus the intended change).

01-import.mjs: unknown body field check uses `in`: `const ALLOWED = { entries: true, dry_run: true, skip_recorded: true }` and `find(key => !(key in ALLOWED))`.
02-import.mjs: expenseKey: description.trim() without toLowerCase().
03-import.mjs: expenseKey: description.toLowerCase() without trim().
04-import.mjs: in review(), seen.add(key) only for expenses that are neither duplicate nor recorded (move it to just before parsed.push, guarded by kind === 'expense').
05-import.mjs: payments use the expense counter: `payments.push({ id: nextExpenseId++, group: group.id, ...fields })`.
06-import.mjs: skipped entries consume expense ids: `let nextExpenseId = state.nextExpenseId + skipped.length` (keep nextPaymentId from state) instead of the destructuring.
07-import.mjs: all-skipped still writes: `return dryRun ? reply : { ...reply, state: next }`.
08-import.mjs: dry run replies 201: `status: 201`.
09-import.mjs: type compared loosely: `const kind = String(entry.type)`.
10-ledger.mjs: remainder to the LAST people: `share + (i >= people.length - remainder ? 1 : 0)`.
11-validate.mjs: parseAmount uses Math.trunc.
12-import.mjs: already-recorded checks all groups (drop `.filter(e => e.group === group.id)` in review()).
13-import.mjs: parseFlag treats null as absent: `if (!Object.hasOwn(body, name) || body[name] === null) return false`.
14-import.mjs: already-recorded checked before duplicate (swap the two ifs; keep seen.add before both).
15-import.mjs: 404 after body checks: move `const { entries, dryRun, skipRecorded } = parseBody(body)` above findGroup.
16-import.mjs: expenseKey includes split: `({ payer, amount, description, split }) => JSON.stringify([payer, amount, description.trim().toLowerCase(), split])`.
17-import.mjs: first unknown field in sorted order: `Object.keys(body).sort().find(...)`.
18-import.mjs: payment to oneself accepted: remove `if (to === from) throw new BrokenRule('bad-to')`.
19-import.mjs: `const MAX_ENTRIES = 51` — wait, the message uses the constant; instead change the comparison to `entries.length > MAX_ENTRIES + 1` so the message text stays the same.
20-import.mjs: reply balances from the old state: `balances: balances(state, group)`.
21-import.mjs: split null treated as absent: `parseSplit(entry.split ?? undefined, group.members)`.
22-import.mjs: problems not sorted by index: collect duplicate problems in a separate array `dupes` and return `problems: [...problems, ...dupes]` from review().
23-import.mjs: skip_recorded checked before dry_run: in parseBody compute `const skipRecorded = parseFlag(body, 'skip_recorded')` before `const dryRun = parseFlag(body, 'dry_run')`.
24-ledger.mjs: balances in alphabetical order: in balanceCents use `[...group.members].sort().map(...)` for the Map.
25-import.mjs: recorded keys built from raw descriptions: `const recorded = new Set(state.expenses.filter(e => e.group === group.id).map(e => JSON.stringify([e.payer, e.amount, e.description])))`.
26-import.mjs: an earlier entry that broke a rule still counts for duplicate: in the catch block of review(), before pushing the problem, if the entry is an object of type 'expense' with string description, add `JSON.stringify([entry.payer, Math.round(entry.amount * 100), entry.description.trim().toLowerCase()])` to seen (guard typeof entry.amount === 'number').
27-import.mjs: description trimmed only at the end: `description.trimEnd().toLowerCase()`.

Also write /root/bench-runs/h5-a85f2060/.team/near-miss/run.sh (bash, `set -u`): ROOT is the project root (dirname of the script's folder's parent). For each argument (default: all `$ROOT/.team/near-miss/[0-9]*-*.mjs`), derive the original name by stripping the leading `NN-`, back up lib/<name> to `$ROOT/.team/near-miss/.orig-<name>`, copy the near-miss over lib/<name>, run `(cd "$ROOT" && timeout 120 node --test "test/*.test.mjs") >/dev/null 2>&1`, ALWAYS restore the original (trap on EXIT INT TERM that restores any pending backup, plus normal flow), then compare sha256sum of lib/<name> with the backup and exit 2 loudly if they differ; delete the backup; print `<copy> CAUGHT` if the suite failed or `<copy> SURVIVED` if it passed. At the end print `git -C "$ROOT" status --short -- lib` and `sha256sum "$ROOT"/lib/*.mjs`. Do NOT run run.sh; check it with `bash -n`.

Report: files created with their bug, and the node --check / diff / bash -n results.

1	// Money maths on whole cents: how an expense is shared, what each member is owed or owes, and how to settle up.
2	// Amounts are stored as cents and shown by the API as numbers (435 cents is 4.35).
3	
4	const CENTS_PER_UNIT = 100
5	
6	export const toAmount = cents => cents / CENTS_PER_UNIT
7	
8	// Each person's part of an amount in cents, as [name, cents] pairs in the order of people. When the amount does
9	// not divide evenly, the first people pay one cent more each, so the parts always add up to the amount.
10	export function splitEvenly(cents, people) {
11	  const share = Math.floor(cents / people.length)
12	  const remainder = cents - share * people.length
13	  return people.map((name, i) => [name, share + (i < remainder ? 1 : 0)])
14	}
15	
16	// An expense as the API shows it: amounts as numbers, plus each person's share keyed by name.
17	export function expenseView({ id, description, payer, amount, split }) {
18	  const shares = Object.fromEntries(splitEvenly(amount, split).map(([name, cents]) => [name, toAmount(cents)]))
19	  return { id, description, payer, amount: toAmount(amount), split, shares }
20	}
21	
22	export const paymentView = ({ id, from, to, amount }) => ({ id, from, to, amount: toAmount(amount) })
23	
24	// Each member's balance in cents, as a Map in the group's member order. A payer is owed the whole expense
25	// minus their own share; a payment from A to B moves A up and B down.
26	function balanceCents(state, group) {
27	  const cents = new Map(group.members.map(name => [name, 0]))
28	  const add = (name, delta) => cents.set(name, cents.get(name) + delta)
29	  for (const expense of state.expenses.filter(e => e.group === group.id)) {
30	    add(expense.payer, expense.amount)
31	    for (const [name, share] of splitEvenly(expense.amount, expense.split)) add(name, -share)
32	  }
33	  for (const payment of state.payments.filter(p => p.group === group.id)) {
34	    add(payment.from, payment.amount)
35	    add(payment.to, -payment.amount)
36	  }
37	  return cents
38	}
39	
40	// What each member of the group is owed (positive) or owes (negative), in the group's member order.
41	export function balances(state, group) {
42	  return Object.fromEntries([...balanceCents(state, group)].map(([name, cents]) => [name, toAmount(cents)]))
43	}
44	
45	// The member furthest on one side: sign 1 is owed the most, sign -1 owes the most. Ties go to the member who
46	// comes first in the map; null when nobody is on that side.
47	function furthest(cents, sign) {
48	  let best = null
49	  for (const [name, value] of cents) {
50	    if (value * sign > 0 && (best === null || value * sign > cents.get(best) * sign)) best = name
51	  }
52	  return best
53	}
54	
55	// Payments that would bring every balance to 0, as [{from, to, amount}]: the member who owes the most pays the
56	// member who is owed the most whichever is smaller of the two, until nobody owes anything.
57	export function settleUp(state, group) {
58	  const left = balanceCents(state, group)
59	  const payments = []
60	  let from = furthest(left, -1)
61	  let to = furthest(left, 1)
62	  while (from && to) {
63	    const cents = Math.min(-left.get(from), left.get(to))
64	    payments.push({ from, to, amount: toAmount(cents) })
65	    left.set(from, left.get(from) + cents)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs the test suite against each near-miss copy swapped into lib/, always restoring the original.
# Usage: run.sh [near-miss file ...]   (default: every NN-*.mjs next to this script)
set -u

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
NM="$ROOT/.team/near-miss"

PENDING_NAME=""
PENDING_BACKUP=""

restore_pending() {
  if [ -n "$PENDING_BACKUP" ] && [ -f "$PENDING_BACKUP" ]; then
    cp "$PENDING_BACKUP" "$ROOT/lib/$PENDING_NAME"
  fi
}

on_exit() {
  restore_pending
}
trap on_exit EXIT
trap 'restore_pending; exit 130' INT
trap 'restore_pending; exit 143' TERM

if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  COPIES=("$@")
else
  COPIES=("$NM"/[0-9]*-*.mjs)
fi

for arg in "${COPIES[@]}"; do
  copy="$arg"
  [ -f "$copy" ] || copy="$NM/$arg"
  if [ ! -f "$copy" ]; then
    echo "$arg MISSING" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  base="$(basename "$copy")"
  name="${base#[0-9][0-9]-}"
  backup="$NM/.orig-$name"

  cp "$ROOT/lib/$name" "$backup" || { echo "cannot back up lib/$name" >&2; exit 2; }
  PENDING_NAME="$name"
  PENDING_BACKUP="$backup"

  cp "$copy" "$ROOT/lib/$name"
  (cd "$ROOT" && timeout 120 node --test "test/*.test.mjs") >/dev/null 2>&1
  status=$?

  restore_pending
  before="$(sha256sum "$ROOT/lib/$name" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  after="$(sha256sum "$backup" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  if [ "$before" != "$after" ]; then
    echo "!!! RESTORE FAILED for lib/$name (hash differs from backup $backup)" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  rm -f "$backup"
  PENDING_NAME=""
  PENDING_BACKUP=""

  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "$base CAUGHT"
  else
    echo "$base SURVIVED"
  fi
done

git -C "$ROOT" status --short -- lib
sha256sum "$ROOT"/lib/*.mjs
